list_of_rare_earth_compounds.compound_name: Dimethylammonium hydrogen tetravacant Dawson selenotungstate incorporating a pentaholmium selenate-water cluster

properties.summary: Photoluminescence emission, excitation, and decay lifetime were studied. The compound exhibits Ho3+ emission sensitized by the selenotungstate framework.

source_locations.location: Experimental Section, synthesis of compound 1; X-ray crystallography

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: A discrete dimeric sandwich polyanion comprises a central [SeO4Ho5(H2O)7]11+ cluster captured through lacunary oxygen atoms by two tetra-vacant Dawson-type [Se2W14O52]12− units. The pentaholmium core contains a bridging selenate group and coordinated water molecules.

synthesis.procedure: Successively dissolved the reagents in water with constant stirring, adjusted the solution pH, added the holmium nitrate solution, and readjusted pH. Heated the resulting solution in a water bath, then cooled and filtered.

reagents.name: dimethylamine hydrochloride
reagents.role: solubilizer and source of dimethylammonium counterions

synthesis.time: 1 h heating; filtrate evaporated at ambient temperature for approximately 4 days
synthesis.vessel_or_method: Aqueous one-pot synthesis; water-bath heating followed by slow evaporation
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Cooled and filtered the reaction solution; slowly evaporated the filtrate at ambient temperature to obtain light-yellow block crystals.
